title: Controllable Cu+/Cu2+ ratio for the gas-sensing property of (Na, Cu) co-doped ZnO investigated by EPR and SPV
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9201-9213
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04390E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qiong Zhang, Liyao Wen, Yifei Sun, Yunkuan Zhao, Huan Yuan, Yaxi Chen, Fei Yu, Kang Zhao, Ming Xu
Increased Na doping promotes the transformation of Cu2+ to Cu+ and introduces more oxygen vacancies of ZnO-based sensors through (Na, Cu) co-doping for room-temperature NO2 detection with a limit as low as 250 ppb.
